tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page background on every app screen and the business portal. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `olive-deep`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, inputs and sheets' inner panels. Sits on `cream` with a `line` border.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented control tracks and the portal sidebar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px borders on cards, list groups and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: line-field
tokens.usage: 1px borders on text fields and selects.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `cream`, `surface` and every tint. Also the dark toast background.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, timestamps, captions. Passes 4.5:1 on `cream` and `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and axis labels only. 2.7:1 on `surface`, so never for real content.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: The primary action: filled buttons, selected chips, active tabs, toggles on. White text on it is 4.4:1, so keep button labels 15px+ bold.

tokens.name: olive-deep
tokens.usage: Olive as text: links, selected labels, active nav label, text on `olive-tint`.

tokens.name: olive-tint
tokens.usage: Selected or confirmed states: Going, Joined, success banners. Text on it in `olive-deep`.

tokens.name: olive-wash
tokens.usage: A selected row or radio card's background, paired with an `olive` border.

tokens.name: olive-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled primary buttons. Label in `olive-disabled-ink`.

tokens.name: olive-disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Label on `olive-disabled`.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: The warm accent: This Week card, date blocks on events, notification dots, A Good Match. White text on it passes.

tokens.name: clay-deep
tokens.usage: Clay as text and icons on `clay-tint` and `match-bg`.

tokens.name: clay-tint
tokens.usage: Badge circles for warm icons, Community labels, the Story option.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Fills only: progress bars, the Featured image gradient. Never text.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Gold as text: Plus and Featured labels, pending states, on `gold-tint`.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: Plus, Featured, In review and Under review backgrounds.

tokens.name: match-bg
tokens.usage: A Good Match screens' background. Text in `match-ink`.

tokens.name: match-ink
tokens.usage: A Good Match headings and names, set in Fraunces italic.

tokens.name: match-line
tokens.usage: Borders on A Good Match cards.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Recording and live only: the record button, the onboarding progress bar, map route lines. Never decoration.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Report, Delete, Log out and errors. White text on it passes.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: The report flag circle.

tokens.name: alert-bg
tokens.usage: The 911 safety alert. Border `alert-line`, text `alert-ink`.

tokens.name: alert-line
tokens.usage: Border of the 911 safety alert.

tokens.name: alert-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside the 911 safety alert.

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Badge circles for olive icons (Training, Community, Settings rows).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The splash wordmark only, stacked on three lines.

styles.name: onboarding-title
styles.usage: Onboarding headings and A Good Match headings. Italic only here, in `olive` or `match-ink`.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The title at the top of each app screen, upright, in `ink`.

styles.name: card-display
styles.usage: Sheet headlines and celebratory card titles.

styles.name: post-title
styles.sample: Golden hour loop before the heat
styles.usage: Activity and post titles in the feed.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Anyone up for an easy run Thursday morning?

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Supporting text in sheets and cards.

styles.name: stat-label
styles.usage: Stat labels, ABOVE the value, Title Case, left-aligned, `ink-muted`.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Stat numbers with tabular figures; the unit beside it in `meta` weight 600.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside small badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between stacked lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between an avatar or badge and its text; padding inside chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and row inner padding.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Screen side padding on every app screen.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in a scrolling screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet top-level gaps in the portal.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every tappable control.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Full-width primary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small icon tiles and type badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, inline banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards and sheet buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, segmented controls, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: The toast above the bottom nav.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Toggle knobs and map buttons. Cards use borders, not shadows.
